name: Sanic the Hawtdawg: Da Movie - Da Game 2.1: Electric Boogaloo 2.2 Version 4 - The Squeakquel: VHS Edition - Directors Cut: Special Edition - The Musical & Knackles
storyline: Follow Sanic The Hawtdawg as he blasts off from CoolPlanet 05 on a spaceship, venturing to Earth for an unforgettable visit! He soon encounters the delightful Princess Peach, and together, they forge an unlikely alliance to thwart the sinister Dr. Egg!
summary: In this unique choose-your-own-adventure, YOU control the fate of Sanic The Hawtdawg. Decide what the characters say and do as you plunge into a hilarious, action-packed narrative.
